design.title: Collaboration history and partner choice
design.researchQuestion: How does prior collaboration change selection of the designated partner?
design.decisionTask: Choose a partner for the next project, or state that no preference is supported.
design.x0: The firm has not collaborated with the designated partner.
design.x1: The firm has successfully collaborated with the designated partner.
sharedFacts: Both partners can complete the project.
The project has a fixed budget.
baselineFacts: Both partners quote the same price.
Both partners meet the technical requirements.
assumptions: Partner selection is a narrow proxy; it does not measure long-term performance.
sourceNotes: This offline fixture is researcher-written and contains no paper evidence.

result.interpretation: Positive-option selections: X0 0/12 (0.0%); X1 12/12 (100.0%). The descriptive X1 minus X0 contrast is +100.0 percentage points. Equivalent and insufficient-information responses stay in the denominators. Mirror agreement is 12/12 complete pairs (100.0%). Boundary diagnostic: X0 near the floor; X1 near the ceiling (5%/95% thresholds). These are descriptive model-generated choices, not human observations or causal estimates.
